Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane arterial road in Houston, Texas, when the vehicle moved into the
adjacent lane and made contact with the side of a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 2 stated that the contact
occurred as Driver 1 attempted a lane change without first confirming the lane was clear. Two independent witnesses
at the scene gave statements consistent with that account, and photographs taken at the location show the damage
to both vehicles, inclduing scraping and deformtaion along the right rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle. The
damage pattern is consistent with a sideswipe impact of this type. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger
seat of Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both officers on scene and the witnesses confirmed the
Passenger's presence in the vehicle. Driver 1 reported a head injury and was observed to be disoriented shortly after
the impact, with symptoms the responding medics considered consistent with a concussion. No prior damage to
Driver 1's vehicle was known to the responding officers or disclosed at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named
insured on the policy covering the vehicle involved.
